Name: Payment data theft
What Happened: A stolen svc-edi credential opened a VPN session, logged on to a finance workstation whose EDR agent had stopped reporting, and moved data out for 4 hours.

Name: Clean month-end
What Happened: No intrusion occurred. Finance worked late and traffic rose, every host reported, and independent records account for every session.

Name: Cold-room blind spot
What Happened: No intrusion occurred, but two cold-chain gateways had neither EDR nor independent logging, so the evidence cannot establish the claim for them. The unmatched session and the egress spike trace to an approved change.

Name: Silent ERP intrusion
What Happened: Monitoring coverage was complete, yet a stolen svc-erp-sync credential reached a monitored ERP server and raised no EDR alert. Only the independent records expose the session.
